title: Morbidity and Mortality: Surgery and Standardized Transmission in Operating Room
official: Morbidity and Mortality in Operating Room: Surgery and Standardized Communication
summary: The primary objective of the study is to evaluate the efficacy of standard handover with AnesList© between physician anesthesists in operating room, for a complete transmission for a patient, on the occurence of event as death, serious complications or rehospitalization in month of postoperative after major surgery.

sites.f: Department of Anesthesia and Intensive Care - Ambroise Paré Hospital - APHP
